text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hear me out, Trainer-kun! The 
dream-version of me pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You've unraveled the mystery of 
the physical body that has long eluded us!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Man, that level of emotion gave me total 
goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Although, the moment I woke up, I 
completely forgot what the mystical vision 
was about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However! I will never forget that feeling 
of exhilaration coursing through my entire 
body...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'd love to savor that once more. We 
must make it a reality no matter what!

Agnes Tachyon seems pleased to have had a 
good dream. I'm just glad she got some 
solid rest.
